name: Rask AI
insight: Built by Brask Inc. (backed by a $6.6M seed); reached $1M ARR within 149 days of its 2023 launch and surpassed a million users.
tagline: AI video localization and dubbing with voice cloning.
description: Rask AI is a video localization and dubbing platform that translates and re-voices video and audio into 130+ languages. It generates synthetic voiceovers with voice cloning in 32 languages, adds automatic lip-sync, detects multiple speakers, and produces translated captions and subtitles. Aimed at creators and marketing teams adapting content for global audiences, it runs in the browser and via API.
edge: Covers 130+ languages with automatic lip-sync — a broader language range than most AI dubbing tools.
cons: Dub quality can vary across languages
